name: frontier-infra
description: Frontier Infra developer tools for building governed agent applications and auditing target deployments with checkable evidence.

plugins.name: frontier-infra
plugins.description: Help developers build standalone governed agent applications. The field kit covers harness architecture, runtime contracts, deterministic drivers, governance gates, health, AVL ground truth, and optional evidence workflows.

plugins.name: frontier-audit
plugins.description: Score repositories against The Machine's conformance kit and optionally issue signed AAR evidence receipts via the published @frontier-infra/audit CLI.
